People don't seem to understand the ability to edit video these days. I could make this video in an afternoon, and the actual effect in about 10 minutes, less if the program I was using was modern enough as many have basic distortion effects with layering like this video uses.

The actual cutting edge of video production can basically make a video that looks like a live broadcast where Bush raps about war crimes for 20 minutes. Mocap and model rendering tecniques are getting crazy, video games are getting a bit of this now which is why we can now actually take screenshots of games that look real, even if the running games still looks off. You couple that stuff with the expensive software that has a multiude of effects that basically let you control the movement and presentation of every pixel in every frame with hundreds of variations from distortion to filters to adaptive elements, many of them working with basic settings.

You get a reality where you can never trust a video, like you can;t trust a picture much anymore, even 5 years ago you could "spot" when a properly done picture was photoshoped. Now you just notice the shitty ones.

Hell you should see what modern films do with green screens, if you get a shot from a film and the director or studio isn't a hard traditionalist you can guarantee that most backdrops, moving segments and often entire scenes are digital. Particularly if the scene is filled with things that aren't close up humans. You get it a lot in AA action films and pretty much all comedies and romance films these days.
